prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1293; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is undergoing ongoing medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

Please provide the complete policy limits for all coverages that may apply to this claim, including bodily injury liability limits, along with a copy of the declarations page for the policy in question. We also request written confirmation of the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes vehicle data and telematics, dashcam or photographic material, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, repair estimates, and any photographs or documents in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such records until this matter is resolved.
